synthesis.base_case_implied: Markets price ~70% probability of no recession, ~70% probability inflation stays below 3%, and 1-2 Fed rate cuts in 2026. This implies a 'soft landing' scenario favorable to HLT's pricing power and demand stability.
synthesis.bear_scenario_implied: ~30% recession probability × elevated inflation risk = meaningful stagflation tail risk (~5-9%). In this scenario, HLT faces simultaneous RevPAR compression and cost inflation.
key_watch_items: Recession probability trend (currently 23-31%, was lower in Jan 2026 - rising trajectory is a warning signal)
Fed rate path (3.50-3.75% current; market expects 1-2 cuts but officials are split)
Inflation trajectory (29% chance of >3% CPI; tariff policy is wildcard)
Unemployment (currently ~4.0-4.1%; any move above 4.5% would signal travel demand weakness)
synthesis.tariff_wildcard: Trump tariff policy (referenced in Polymarket court/refund markets) is a key unpriced risk for international travel demand and supply chain costs for hotel construction/renovation
